summary: Fractal web's agent inspector opens on a native Details tab built on the Fractal UI DetailsPane, with Changes as its second tab. Details shows identity, mission, status, managed-session timing, context, spend, resources and traced subagents from native observations and names every unreported or ungranted value. Resources opens in a new non-modal Fractal UI SidePanel instead of a modal dialog, lists the agent's Todos first, and prefetches and retains its reads so a reopen shows the last observation.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Additive: Fractal UI exports SidePanel and SidePanelProps from its shell entry. Details reads use existing client read endpoints and request redacted declaration values only. Resources is no longer a dialog; it is a labelled complementary region named by the trigger's aria-controls.
